acts.name: Signal
acts.purpose: A dormant orb detects a distant impossible transmission.
acts.secondaryAction: A single distant beacon sweeps across the dead moon while the surrounding ruins remain still.
acts.dominantShape: dead-moon crescent cut by a needle beacon
acts.foreground: black regolith ledge and fractured ruin silhouettes
acts.midgroundSubject: small dormant orb isolated against lunar shadow
acts.backgroundLandmark: dead moon horizon and distant signal beacon
acts.atmosphere: sparse cold dust with near-vacuum stillness
acts.keyDirection: hard lunar rim from the upper right with one warm distant beacon

acts.name: Awakening
acts.purpose: Ancient ruins answer and the orb awakens to agency.
acts.secondaryAction: Sealed chamber petals open and reactivation bands climb around the protagonist.
acts.dominantShape: opening iris chamber enclosing the orb
acts.foreground: dark chamber ribs crossing the near frame
acts.midgroundSubject: awakened orb held inside the opening structure
acts.atmosphere: enclosed teal haze with warm reactivation spill
acts.keyDirection: warm chamber light opening from below against a cool teal rim

acts.name: Departure
acts.purpose: The protagonist leaves safety and commits to the journey.
acts.secondaryAction: Guide packets ignite in sequence and race down the monumental travel corridor.
acts.dominantShape: repeating launch ribs converging on a vanishing point
acts.foreground: monumental near pylons and converging floor rails
acts.midgroundSubject: travelling orb advancing between illuminated guide lanes
acts.backgroundLandmark: deep cobalt launch corridor vanishing point
acts.atmosphere: lengthening cobalt depth haze with hot white guide light
acts.keyDirection: repeating corridor ribs backlight the subject along the travel axis

acts.name: Gates
acts.purpose: The first threshold tests speed, scale, and resolve, then changes the route behind the protagonist.
acts.secondaryAction: The split monolith reacts, releases an expanding shockwave, and seals the route behind the crossing.
acts.dominantShape: split monolith diamond threshold larger than frame
acts.foreground: asymmetric black gate occluders on both frame edges
acts.midgroundSubject: orb crossing the bright threshold membrane
acts.backgroundLandmark: green-white gate aperture and altered space beyond
acts.atmosphere: compressed indigo haze ruptured by an emerald-white shockwave
acts.keyDirection: threshold backlight silhouettes the subject and foreground monoliths

acts.name: Rupture
acts.purpose: The route breaks and the protagonist is visibly damaged.
acts.secondaryAction: A fractured route plane shears away behind the damaged protagonist.
acts.midgroundSubject: damaged orb tumbling across the fracture
acts.atmosphere: desaturated vacuum with red fracture glints

acts.name: Transformation
acts.purpose: The broken orb is rebuilt into a new luminous form.
acts.secondaryAction: Megastructure arms align and rebuild the orb layer by layer.
acts.foreground: mechanical arms crossing the near frame
acts.keyDirection: radial reconstruction light converges on the subject

acts.name: Arrival
acts.purpose: The transformed protagonist reaches Andromeda and finds scale beyond itself.
acts.secondaryAction: A distant galactic horizon unfolds beyond the now transformed protagonist.
acts.midgroundSubject: transformed orb suspended in calm space
acts.backgroundLandmark: Andromeda horizon and impossible scale markers
acts.keyDirection: broad galactic backlight with a soft frontal return
